Plate It App

Sep 18, 2026 08:18

Today, I’ve built an app called Plate It.

Plate It can take a recipe from almost any video source or webpage and record it in an easy to view format. No more ads and no more endless scrolling to find the bloody recipe.

It can translate recipes into different languages, build grocery lists, create meal plans, bookmark favorites, tag recipes for allergies, search through everything, and let me share recipes with friends and family.
